decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +0.8% and S&P 500 +0.7% today — a mildly positive, not strongly risk-on, session. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 buy threshold, so no new positions were opened, and no existing holdings showed cause for sale.

market_education.summary_en: Markets drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, a broad-based grind rather than a sharp risk-on rally. No specific catalyst headlines were available in today's news feed to attribute the move to a single event. With gains this mild across the index, the case for chasing new positions was weak.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，納指升0.8%，標普500升0.7%，屬普遍性的溫和上漲而非明顯的risk-on走勢。今日新聞來源未提供具體消息面因素可解釋今次升幅。由於大市升幅有限，追入新持倉的理據不強。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a stronger opportunity appears. With only $189.29 in cash — below the $500 minimum needed to open a new position — the agent held rather than forcing a trade on a merely neutral-to-mildly-positive day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留在場邊、等待更佳機會時才動用的現金。由於現金僅得189.29美元，未達開新倉所需的500美元門檻，加上今日只屬溫和向好，因此選擇持有現金，不勉強進場。
